  "headline": "Net revenue fell -11.2% (Rs 165,085) in the week to 7 Aug.",
  "sentences": [
    { "text": "The net revenue fell by -11.2% (Rs 165,085) in the week 1‑7 Aug compared with the prior week.", "tier_from": "answer.headline_tier" },
    { "text": "The primary hypothesis attributes the drop to a movement localized to the Smart Home category on the Web channel.", "tier_from": "drivers[0]" },
    { "text": "A difference‑in‑differences test showed the treated segment moved -31.1% versus a 0.0% control (z = ‑15.5), and the test survived.", "tier_from": "drivers[0].tests[0]" },
    { "text": "A placebo‑timing test yielded a diff‑in‑diff of -14.7 pp against a noise standard of 2.0 pp (2 windows); the result survived.", "tier_from": "drivers[0].tests[1]" },
    { "text": "An unaffected‑control check confirmed the control segment moved 0.0%, supporting isolation of the effect.", "tier_from": "drivers[0].tests[2]" },
    { "text": "Pre‑period contamination checks indicated stability between comparison periods, and the test survived.", "tier_from": "drivers[0].tests[3]" },
    { "text": "The rival‑channel hypothesis (broader Web movement) produced a treated move of -31.1% versus a 7.1% control, giving a DID of -38.2 pp, which survived.", "tier_from": "drivers[1].tests[0]" },
    { "text": "The broader Smart Home category was rejected as a confound because its rival scope moved only 7.0% versus the segment’s 31.1%, a magnitude mismatch.", "tier_from": "rejected_hypotheses[0]" },
    { "text": "Decomposition shows volume contributed -148,528 (92.4% of the drop), mix added +3,528 (‑2.2%), and price contributed -15,816 (9.8%).", "tier_from": "decomposition[0]" },
    { "text": "The localized segment (Smart Home / Web) contributed -185,577 (112.4% of total movement) based on 67 observations.", "tier_from": "localization[0]" },
    { "text": "The South region within Smart Home contributed -103,502 (62.7%) with 55 observations, indicating regional spill‑over.", "tier_from": "localization[1]" }
  ]
}
